'''Volume 9''' is the ninth of ten volumes of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga created by [[Yumi Tsukirino]].

==Blurb==
''It's boys versus girls in the Pokémon Sports Meet! For super-competitive Charmander, being stuck with all the incompetent Pokémon on its team is already a giant headache, but what's going to happen when it sees the injured and exhausted Chikorita take a fall? Will this finally trigger the hidden gentleman in our blazing, hot-headed friend?!''

* The Pokémon participate in a sports meet.
* {{MPJ|Pikachu}} and {{MPJ|Clefairy}} meet {{p|Totodile}}.
* [[Hazel]] and [[Coconut]] meet [[Apricot]] for the first time.
* [[Plum]] and {{MPJ|Chansey}} are introduced.
* [[Marimaru]] gets {{MPJ|Squirtle}} to pretend to be her boyfriend to impress her friends.
